description: Manage self-hosted model bridges (your model on your hardware pre-labels OpenTrain work; the model never transits OpenTrain). action=list shows the registry with health heartbeats; action=mint creates a one-shot pairing code (shown once); action=revoke kills a bridge's token. Requires open-label:read (list) / open-label:write (mint, revoke) and the workflow_agents feature.
name: open_label_bridge
